title: Does the LAMMPS Cu EAM force and full virial tensor match energy derivatives?
objective: Qualify the LAMMPS energy/force/stress data contract on a nontrivial many-body periodic solid before importing MLIP results into the research system.

scientificScope.whyNew: Exercises LAMMPS EAM interpolation, embedding-force chain rule, periodic virial, full six-component strain response, and signed/unit-aware output. It does not repeat the old two-atom LJ, four-atom EMT, or NEP development-set audit.

hypothesis: For this fixed Cu EAM solid, LAMMPS Cartesian forces equal minus the central energy derivative and its pair-only global pressure equals minus the affine strain-energy derivative divided by baseline volume; sum(stress/atom)/volume equals the negative pressure tensor.

system.lattice: FCC, 3 x 3 x 3 conventional cells; 4 basis sites/cell
system.ordering: Enumerate ix=0..2 outermost, iy=0..2, iz=0..2, basis index=0..3 innermost; atom ID = 1 + 4*(9*ix+3*iy+iz)+basis index.
system.baselineCell: H0 = diag(3*a0*1.010, 3*a0*0.995, 3*a0*1.002); Cartesian column vectors r = H0*s.
system.fractionalCoordinates: s = (cell index + basis)/3; add the Cartesian perturbation below, then wrap through H0 into [0,1).
system.perturbation: For atom ID i, raw displacement in Angstrom = 0.01*[sin(17*i), cos(13*i), sin(7*i)] using radians; subtract the mean displacement over all 108 atoms. Freeze generated Cartesian positions to 15 significant decimal digits before execution and retain their checksum.
fixtureChecks: Exactly108 finite unique IDs and type1 only
All evaluated structures remain at least0.02 Angstrom away from the4.95 Angstrom force cutoff for every pair distance
No EAM density-table extrapolation warning; any such warning makes the case unqualified

computes: compute P all pressure NULL pair
compute S all stress/atom NULL pair
compute Ssum all reduce sum c_S[1] c_S[2] c_S[3] c_S[4] c_S[5] c_S[6]
lammpsConfiguration.staticEvaluation: Each fresh structure receives run 0 with default pre yes. Never use pre no after changing positions or box; no integrator or thermostat is installed.
lammpsConfiguration.conversionSource: src/update.cpp Update::set_units metal branch, line181. This code-contract test uses the exact pinned LAMMPS constant, not a silently substituted modern SI rounding.

evaluationPlan.forcePerturbation: For each axis/step/sign, restore exact baseline then displace only atom54 by +/-h along that Cartesian axis at fixed H0. Wrap only as a representation change; retain unwrapped intended coordinate.
evaluationPlan.strainPerturbation: For each component/step/sign, restore exact baseline then H(g)=F(g)*H0 and r_i(g)=F(g)*r_i0 at fixed fractional coordinates. xx/yy/zz: F=I+g*e_a*e_a^T. xy/xz/yz: F=I+g*e_a*e_b^T with a<b; these are engineering simple-shear parameters, not symmetric tensor strains. No factor of2 is added.
evaluationPlan.energyFormat: Retain total pair energy using at least17 significant decimal digits; do not use normalized per-atom thermo energy for derivatives.

observables.pressureFiniteDifference: P_FD(ab;h) = -1602176.5*[U(F(+h))-U(F(-h))]/(2*h*V0) bar, where the exact deformation generators above define each derivative and V0=det(H0).
observables.pressureStressJoin: For each evaluated configuration g and all6 components: P_LAMMPS(g)[ab] + sum_i S_i(g)[ab]/V(g) =0 in bar; V(g)=det(H(g)). Use pair-only terms on both sides. V(g)=V0 only for baseline and fixed-cell atom displacements.
observables.forceBalance: sum_i F_i=0 within a floating-point-scaled residual; record all three components without using this identity alone to certify correctness.
observables.comparisonTargets: Every finite-difference estimate is compared against forces or pressure from the single unperturbed baseline configuration. V0 is used only in the baseline strain-energy derivative. The per-atom/global stress closure is checked independently at every one of the55 configurations using that configuration's own volume.

predeclaredAcceptance.finiteValuesAndIdentity: Every required scalar/vector finite; exactly108 atoms/IDs and exact intended box/coordinates within text-rounding tolerance; all55 outputs present once.
predeclaredAcceptance.stressPressureIdentity: For each of55 evaluated configurations and all6 components: |P(g)+sum(S(g))/V(g)| <=1e-6 +1e-10*max(|P(g)|,|sum(S(g))/V(g)|) bar.
predeclaredAcceptance.rationale: These are proposed numerical contract tolerances, not copper accuracy thresholds. Three steps expose truncation/roundoff or table-knot sensitivity. Absolute floors avoid meaningless relative errors near zero. The EAM interpolation is tabulated, so a universal fourfold h-halving improvement is not assumed. Both the smallest-step residual and two-finest-step agreement must pass; observed failure cannot be repaired by silently changing tolerance or spending extra evaluations.
predeclaredAcceptance.falsifier: Any finite-difference or sign/unit/tensor-order residual above its threshold, nonconvergent two-finest estimate, wrong/missing identity, warning, or process failure leaves this contract unqualified; retain all results for a separately reviewed correction.

requiredBeforeExecution: A concrete reviewed adapter/runner with checksum that enforces55 fixed evaluations, time/memory/output limits, offline execution and terminal cleanup.
Exact LAMMPS executable SHA256, platform/architecture, compiler/toolchain/flags, package list proving MANYBODY, and pinned-source build receipt; an executable version string alone is insufficient.

Freeze generated input.data, generator, every evaluated coordinate/cell projection, analysis code and manifest SHA256; all null pins must be resolved in a new immutable executable manifest, not edited into this proposal.
Confirm approved local compute resource and available disk/memory without changing historical research tasks or scheduled check-ins.
Independently review affine shear tensor convention and planned fixture cutoff/table-domain checks.

followOnIfQualified.proposal: Reuse this exact output contract on a separately chosen and versioned MLIP, then investigate a held-out strained/defect configuration chain against independently qualified DFT or measured references. Same-engine finite-difference agreement is necessary for an adapter but cannot establish transferability.
mustNotInfer: No claim that Cu_u3 is accurate for all copper states
No validation of earlier NEP development labels
No MLIP superiority from classical EAM checks
No causal knowledge graph edge from source review alone

priorEvidenceRead.relevance: Existing33-check hosted audit already used3x108-atom frames and11 evaluations including force/isotropic-pressure derivatives; preserve it separately.

supersedesProposal.reason: Separate baseline-volume finite-difference comparison from each evaluated configuration's own-volume stress closure.
